title: QAM-Aware RFNet V3.3 — pre-training preparation
scope: audit, design, code, tests, short smoke, AutoDL packaging only (no formal GPU training, no board bring-up, no SDR, no frozen-asset modification)

architecture.backbone: frozen V2 (time 22ch conv + physical 8ch encoder + FusionClassifier 120/64/8)
architecture.residual_expert: BoundedResidualExpert on E[x^1..x^4] of 3 physical planes (12->32->8), zero gate
architecture.combine: logits = v2_logits + clamp(gate * delta, +-1.0); clamp on FINAL residual, Add/Mul/Relu only

phase5_numerical_stability_fix.trigger: real RTX 5090 Stage-1 failed: RuntimeError 'V3.3 training produced a non-finite loss'
phase5_numerical_stability_fix.root_cause: -20 dB samples reach iq_max_abs ~ 29.84 and PowerLagOneFeatures physical_max_abs ~ 975.61; HigherOrderMomentPool under FP16 autocast overflows (order-2 = Inf, order-4 = NaN; FP16 max ~ 65504)
phase5_numerical_stability_fix.fix_input_clamp: deployable clamp to [-2, 2] BEFORE HigherOrderMomentPool, built from Add/Mul/Relu over pre-registered 1-D buffers (_input_bound=2.0, _input_two_bound=4.0, _neg_one); matches the deployment physical-dequant range int8[-127,127] * (2/127) = [-2, 2]

loss_fp32.no_nan_swallow: non-finite loss raises RuntimeError with full diagnostics; NaN is never replaced by 0 or dropped

tests.cpu_numeric: tests/test_qam_aware_v3_3_numeric_cpu.py (deploy contract; -20 dB physical > 2 clamped to <= 2; FP16 overflow reproduced without clamp + fixed with clamp; full-SNR forward finite + zero-gate residual bounded)
tests.full_snr_cuda: tests/test_qam_aware_v3_3_full_snr_cuda.py (release-blocking; A1/A2/A3 over full 21-SNR; FP16 autocast on; forward/each-loss/total/backward/gradients/step finite; |expert input| <= 2; order-4 finite; gate=0 init equivalence; residual <= bound; ONNX checker/opset17/8-op whitelist; skipif CPU)
tests.preflight_step2: run_preflight.sh step [2] runs the full-SNR CUDA gate BEFORE the 2-epoch smoke; any non-finite -> no marker

phase5_1_test_isolation_fix.scope: test-only device-isolation fix in tests/test_qam_aware_v3_3_full_snr_cuda.py; no model/clamp/trainer/loss/dataset/SNR/LR/epoch/search/selection/acceptance/build_partition-shared-semantics change
phase5_1_test_isolation_fix.root_cause: build_qam_aware_v3_3_partition(student) returns student.core (parameters shared); .cpu() on it moved the live CUDA student's backbone off cuda:0, so the post-export extreme-residual check fed CUDA input to CPU weights
phase5_1_test_isolation_fix.fix: export graph built as copy.deepcopy(source_partition).eval().cpu() (independent copy; verified 0 shared param/buffer tensors), then assert every live student parameter and buffer is still exactly on cuda:0 before weights-x50 / gate=100 residual-bound check
phase5_1_test_isolation_fix.not_a_model_or_clamp_failure: A1/A2/A3 had already completed full 21-SNR FP16-autocast train/val with finite loss/grad/params and finite -20 dB forward; the failure occurred only after the ONNX export step

narrow_search.target: actual Stage-1 winning mechanism (never a fixed A3)

deployment_contract_unchanged.quant: SInt8 NCL, dequant 1/127 (IQ) and 2/127 (physical), zero-point 0, round-nearest-away-from-zero, saturate [-127,127]

tests.skipped_reason: all CUDA-only cases (tiny trainer CUDA smoke + real-model CUDA integration + full-SNR numeric gate) skipped on the CPU host; none is ever counted as a CUDA pass

smoke_pipeline.onnx_export: operator gate passed (no unexpected operators), clamp path active with residual_bound=1.0
smoke_pipeline.note: 2-epoch smoke shows FP32-vs-FPGA-sim accuracy gap 0.087 > 0.03 floor; expected for an undertrained model, watch in formal run (A3 consistency loss is the remedy)

selection_rule: two-validation-seed lexicographic: mean macro-F1 (desc) > worst-seed macro-F1 (desc) > worst-domain OOD macro-F1 (desc) > mean accuracy (desc) > mean QAM (desc) > worst-class regression vs same-seed A0 (asc) > FPGA-sim gap (asc) > name; A0 can win
stage1_regression_baseline: same-seed A0 (real inference on v3_3_validation); each OOD domain compared same-seed same-domain; never acceptance.yaml V2 test per-class

pipeline_gates.preflight: functional smoke only (tests + 2-epoch train/eval/export); does NOT certify performance
pipeline_gates.pilot: performance gate (Stage-1 ablation + validation/OOD selection + threshold); sole entry to formal
pipeline_gates.hash_guard_scope: model + trainer + evaluators + selection + narrow-search code + Stage-1 (search + pilot-gate) config + acceptance + dataset/channel config + V2 checkpoint hash

superseded_sha256: a423f7d21dcb8a4b22c0222fade69221199ebf0d7f74ec9b03dd250d4d5555a3 (DISCARDED — Phase 5 build before the 5.1 test-isolation fix)

cuda_preflight.requirement: must print V3_3_PREFLIGHT_FUNCTIONAL_PASS on the real GPU before formal training is considered fully ready
cuda_preflight.full_snr_gate: run_preflight.sh step [2] runs tests/test_qam_aware_v3_3_full_snr_cuda.py (A1/A2/A3, 21-SNR, FP16 autocast, input clamp, per-component/grad/param finiteness, ONNX 8-op gate) BEFORE the 2-epoch smoke; any non-finite loss aborts with diagnostics and no marker is written
bugs_fixed: CUDA test assertion now logits.is_cuda (index-robust) instead of logits.device == torch.device('cuda')
verify_init_matches_v2 shared input built on next(model.parameters()).device
_finite_probe DataLoader inputs moved to the model device
defensive: verify_qam_aware_v3_3_init.py shared input on the student device

GPU resume: structured checkpoint loaded map_location='cpu' (not self.device) so the DataLoader generator + CPU/CUDA RNG states stay CPU ByteTensor; optimizer state migrated to the exact CUDA device; AMP scaler state (scalar-only in torch 2.8) restored device-free; legacy migration path audited

CUDA RNG restore: torch.cuda.get_rng_state_all() returns list[ByteTensor] (not a single tensor); restore_rng_state now validates list/tuple + device count and restores element-wise on CPU before set_rng_state_all (the prior .detach().cpu() on the list would raise AttributeError on GPU)

Resume history: load_resume restores round-1 history and fit appends round 2, so the resumed fit() returns [1,2]; CUDA test assertion corrected to [1,2] / len==2 / [-1]['epoch']==2 (no history clearing, no weakened assertion); resume test now perturbs all RNG before load_resume and asserts exact restoration of generator/CPU-RNG/CUDA-RNG-per-device/Python/NumPy/scheduler/AMP-scaler/optimizer-on-cuda:0
cuda_preflight.new_cuda_test: tests/test_qam_aware_v3_3_cuda.py (14 coverage points incl. the CUDA resume round-trip against the real V2 champion + real V3.3 model; every RNG source is perturbed before load_resume to prove restoration, cumulative [1,2] history asserted; skipped on CPU only)
cuda_preflight.run_preflight_hard_gate: asserts torch.cuda.is_available(), prints runtime, runs the CUDA test first, writes V3_3_PREFLIGHT_DONE only after every step; hash covers all test files + init-equivalence script + resume core
cuda_preflight.run_complete_gate: requires the CUDA preflight marker with a source-hash match before entering the pilot
cuda_preflight.hash_guard_resume_core: preflight + pilot INPUT_HASH now include training/resumable_trainer.py, training/trainer.py, training/utils.py, and the resume-related tests

autodl_command: bash autodl_v3_3/run_preflight.sh (CUDA preflight-only first stage; run_complete.sh only after V3_3_PREFLIGHT_FUNCTIONAL_PASS is pasted back)
remaining_risks: FPGA-sim gap under formal training must clear the 0.03 floor (A3 consistency loss is the intended remedy if A1 alone cannot)
QAM gain must not regress non-QAM classes beyond the per-class floors; A0 'V2 can win' fallback bounds this
